# Learning By Design AI

> We build a shared AI brain inside your team, then ship AI agents and workflows that pay for themselves, measured against your own baseline. Lead offer: your first 3 ROI-positive AI agents, live in 3 months. Founded by David Fu (CEO) and Vedansh Garg (CTO).

Our point of view: AI transformation is a human agency problem disguised as a technology problem. AI ROI comes from amplifying people's judgment and expertise, not extracting it to cut headcount (Amplifying > Extracting). Our goal is to close the agency gap in 1,000 companies by 2030, without a single AI-driven layoff.

## The offer: your first 3 ROI-positive AI agents in 3 months

- Weeks 1 to 2, baseline: interviews, a workflow map and today's numbers.
- Weeks 3 to 4, brain and workflow 1: data, metrics and know-how in one layer; the first workflow goes live.
- Month 2, champions and workflow 2: leaders and champions learn to build their own skills.
- Month 3, workflow 3 and an ROI scorecard measured against the baseline.

## The AI capability loop

Start with one workflow that matters. Each layer creates the need for the next:

1. The brain: app data, CRM, pricing and Drive, connected once.
2. Skills directory: how each team works, written once as skills anyone can call.
3. Workflows: skills chained into jobs that run end to end.
4. Apps: every team ships its own tools on the same brain, with one login.
5. Semantic and metric layer: every metric defined once. New teams join, back to 1.

In parallel, token spend is optimized continuously (small models for routine steps, caching, quarterly reviews of top token sinks), so cost per task falls as usage grows. One startup went from $2,000 to $300 a month.

## Recent work

- JPMorgan Chase, research and strategy lead: building the firm's own taxonomy agent in place of an outside tagging vendor.
- JPMorgan Chase, technology program management lead: a stand-up summarizer and a 13-program portfolio report agent.
- Target, regional corporate security leader: an audit workflow that compares quarters automatically, and a sourced benchmark deck.
- PNC, private banking market leader: a weekly agent across four calendars with scoped permissions.
- Enterprise cohort outcomes: AI fluency 7% to 75%; confident AI use 49% to 86%; 90%+ completion.
- Vet talent marketplace (~$40M ARR): paid ads agent live in two weeks, 500+ ads pushed.
- Investment bank (medical science): 8 source systems in one brain, 58 skills on top.
- 100 School: $1M+ B2B pipeline and $150K closed.
- ReachAll AI (voice AI, built by Vedansh): under 300ms latency, 3x lower cost, 99.99% uptime; acquired by IKEA's parent company.
- Also built with: TrustVet, Edstruments, Chestnut, Locust Walk, Springboard, Roo, Willow, Cloudforce.
